title: Theodore B. Lewis
vital_facts: Fought to defend the Sacred Soil of Dixie 1861 until captured
Married Martha Jane Coray 1870; practiced plural marriage; seventeen children
Sustained Seventy and member of First Council of Seventy, 1882, but not set apart. (See text.)
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
